doc.md:
Values for the [`Settings:gtk-interface-reduced-motion`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Settings#property:gtk-interface-reduced-motion)
and [`CssProvider:prefers-reduced-motion`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CssProvider#property:prefers-reduced-motion) properties
that indicates the preferred level of motion animations.

This information can be used inside CSS via media queries.

no_preference.brief: The user has made no preference known to the system
no_preference.md: The user has made no preference known to the system

reduce.md:
The user has notified the system that they
  prefer an interface that removes or replaces the types of motion-based
  animation that either trigger discomfort for those with vestibular
  motion sensitivity, or distraction for those with attention deficits
